name: Security Updates Check
description: Nightly read-only security sweep: pending updates, dependency advisories, open ports, exposed credentials, MCP config. Reports only, never changes anything.

payload.message: [Security Updates Check] Execute the routine bundled with this job exactly as written; it was passed to you in full. Do the work directly in this isolated cron turn; do NOT spawn another agent. Write the run report the routine requires before finishing. Return only a short delta summary as your final response (max 8 lines).
